title: Idle settle-snap across the first viewport
summary: Lenis on the shared ticker; a wheel that rests inside the first viewport (outside a `6 %` dead zone at each end) eases to the nearer end after `160 ms` of quiet counted in ticker time (`.7 s` ease-out cubic, not locked, so a wheel takes over), `900 ms` guard; held while a pointer is down (a press stops it in place), disarmed by keyboard, find-in-page and other native scrolls and never armed by touch; off on coarse pointers and under reduced motion
variants: first viewport, nearer end after 160 ms of quiet, .7 s ease-out cubic, 900 ms guard (this, default)
nearest section top within 45 % of the viewport, 140 ms of quiet, .9 s ease-out cubic
